lead.title: MED-EL opens its post-market study of the first cochlear implant with no external parts at six European centers
lead.deck: On Nov. 11 the Austrian manufacturer began enrolling its post-market clinical follow-up study (PMCF, NCT07897318) of the Mi2000 TICI, sold as TICI UNICO: 22 patients are planned in Vienna (AKH), Antwerp, Liège, Munich, Würzburg and Nadarzyn (Poland). Launched in late September with CE marking, the implant places the microphone, processor and rechargeable battery under the skin; this real-world data will shape uptake by European implant centers, while the only comparable rival, US-based Envoy Medical, is still in its US pivotal trial.

milestone.title: bioMérieux wins FDA clearance and IVDR CE marking for VITEK PRO, its bacterial identification and susceptibility testing system
milestone.summary: VITEK PRO combines microbial identification and antimicrobial susceptibility testing on a single platform for medium- and high-volume microbiology labs. The Lyon-area group plans a Q1 2027 launch in the US and selected European countries, then a worldwide rollout in Q2 to replace its VITEK 2 and VITEK XL systems.
milestone.why: Replacing a global installed base of lab analyzers is rare: it sets the routine susceptibility-testing standard for years, just as antimicrobial resistance pushes hospitals to pick the right antibiotic faster. For rapid-AST startups it is the new benchmark to beat, and one more reason to aim for integration rather than replacement.

brefsEurope.title: Aliko Scientific unveils its CYTOfast Auto liquid-based cytology system at MEDICA
brefsEurope.summary: The Euronext Growth-listed company is showing, Nov. 16–19 in Düsseldorf, the fully automated system from its Italian subsidiary Hospitex, which determines the sample volume needed for each slide and tracks every sample to its slide. The announcement does not yet mention CE marking: the step to watch before any sales.

brefsEurope.title: 3Deus Dynamics has already secured €5.75M of a €7M round to industrialize its silicone anatomical simulators
brefsEurope.summary: Founded in 2020, the company uses its patented Dynamic Molding process to 3D-print vessel replicas without molds or supports that mimic tissue distensibility, used to validate devices before clinical trials. The balance is open to individual investors via Sowefund until Dec. 15; the institutional investors are not named.

brefsEurope.title: Diasorin wins IVDR CE marking for its LIAISON PLEX gastrointestinal and respiratory "Flex" panels
brefsEurope.summary: The gastrointestinal panel detects up to 24 bacterial, viral and parasitic targets and the respiratory panel up to 19, with software that lets labs pay only for the targets they order. The Italian group will bring this approach to European labs in Q1 2027.

brefsEurope.title: Bioretec's bioabsorbable implant sales jump 85.5% in the third quarter
brefsEurope.summary: The Finnish company booked €1.33M in quarterly revenue, driven by its Activa bioabsorbable polymer screws (more than 500,000 units sold to date) and the FDA clearance won in September for a new compression screw. Its magnesium-alloy RemeOs range holds three Breakthrough Device designations; cash stands at €9.25M.

brefsIntl.title: Mosaic Intelligence Labs emerges from stealth with a $47M seed to robotically navigate blood vessels
brefsIntl.summary: The startup is building sensing instruments, spatial mapping and robots for endovascular procedures, including a semi-autonomous catheter; two rounds led by 8VC and Fundomo, with Lingotto Innovation and Obvious Ventures. A seed this size sets a valuation marker for European endovascular robotics players.

brefsIntl.title: Olympus says it is making progress with the FDA after a new warning letter on its endoscopes
brefsIntl.summary: CEO Bob White says quality remediation has intensified since January, following the October letter covering six sites in Japan, Europe and the US and new import alerts. The holds have already cost about ¥9B in revenue: a risk that opens room for alternative endoscopes.

brefsIntl.title: Technion publishes SPADE, a miniature sensor that measures blood pressure continuously without a cuff
brefsIntl.summary: Published in Nature Communications, the sensor combines silicon photonics and optoacoustics to measure the artery's absolute diameter with each heartbeat, then reconstructs the pressure waveform with an AI model, at 100 measurements per second in volunteers. A proof of concept that could eventually fit into watches or patches.

word.definition: An electronic device, partly placed by surgery, that bypasses the damaged part of the inner ear and directly stimulates the auditory nerve to restore a sense of sound to people who are profoundly deaf or severely hard of hearing.

parts.label: Microphone and processor
parts.role: pick up sound and turn it into a coded signal; traditionally worn behind the ear, now under the skin on totally implantable models

parts.label: Receiver-stimulator
parts.role: implanted under the skin, it converts the signal into electrical impulses

parts.label: Electrode array
parts.role: inserted into the cochlea, it delivers the impulses to different regions of the auditory nerve

how.t: The microphone picks up sounds and the processor selects and encodes those that carry speech.
The signal reaches the implanted receiver-stimulator, through the skin on a conventional implant, directly on a totally implantable one.
The electrodes stimulate the auditory nerve; through rehabilitation, the brain learns to interpret this new form of hearing.

word.why: The most mature neuroprosthetics market (about 737,000 devices implanted worldwide as of 2019, per the FDA) is locked up by a handful of players but is entering a new phase: the fully invisible implant (MED-EL's TICI UNICO, CE-marked in 2026; Envoy Medical's Acclaim in a US pivotal trial) and robotic electrode insertion to preserve residual hearing. For investors, value is shifting to whatever widens indications and improves outcomes: batteries, electrodes, assisted surgery.
